0.text: Oh! $NAME! I was beginning to think you’d gotten yourself caught while escaping! I’m glad you let me get out on my own.

1.text: My brother Markos is so brave and I hope I can be like him one day, but he always worries too much about me. He would never had let me find my own way out.

2.text: I told him, I’m as good a Knight as anyone else here. He made me an honorary squire… But I think he’s coddling me. Hey,  at least I get to say I’m part of the rebel army!

3.text: Oh Father! This is the *cough* “Enforcer” I told you about! The one who helped me find my way home!

4.text: Say hi to my Father, I’m sure he will be very charitable, if you get my drift.
